entities.name: Assad's Corrective Revolution
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Assad's Corrective Revolution, a transformative movement in Syria (1963–1970). Emerged from Hafez al-Assad seizes power in the 'Corrective Movement' coup and Syria and Egypt form the United Arab Republic. Catalyzed Israel captures the Golan Heights from Syria in the Six-Day War and Syria and Egypt launch the October/Yom Kippur War against Israel.
